name: tutorial-steps-visual
description: Step-by-step visual walkthrough of all 23 tutorial steps (0-22) with per-step screenshots for visual regression testing. Exercises the tutorial overlay from start through congratulations, capturing each step's UI state, highlight targets, and progress indicator.

steps.description: Left unmarked: `tutorial_start` (step 2) arms the tutorial's own rails (tutorialStages.ts) -- off-target controls go inert until the tutorial's current stage points at them (scenario-defs.md: "a scenario that clicks what the current step does not allow is asserting something no player could do"). The first interaction-mode run confirmed this: `survey`'s tile-select confirm was inert, "blocking" per the tutorial rail, not a missing selector. Reaching each control for real needs the same `waitForTutorialStep` gating tutorial-interactive.json uses between every click, keyed to this file's own stage sequence -- not yet mapped out, left as commands rather than guess at stage ids and risk a false pass. A real conversion of this file is future work, matching tutorial-interactive.
